Phase 1 experts: Adriana Tapus (ENSTA-ParisTech), Michael Henshaw (Loughborough University), Bram Vanderborght (Vrije Universiteit Brussel), Eldert J. van Henten (Wageningen University), Fred van Houten (University of Twente), Stamatis Karnouskos (SAP), Haydn Thompson (Haydn Consulting).
